subject: Stratos - cross-team alignment: capacity estimate & pricing review
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Intro follow-up — workshop to align on sizing & pricing

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday. Per our conversation, it would be helpful to run a short cross-team workshop to align on:
- current usage profile and near-term forecast (you mentioned spike during product launch)
- dedicated capacity sizing options and trade-offs (throughput vs cost)
- pricing/contract framing for a reserved commitment vs burst model

Suggested agenda (30–45m):
1) Quick intros + goals (5m)
2) Stratos usage profile & Q1 forecast (5–10m) — Alice / Ethan
3) Dedicated sizing recommendations (Soojín)
4) Pricing/options and next steps (Ben / Markus)

Proposed time windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-01-20 09:00–09:45
- Tue 2026-01-20 12:00–12:45
- Wed 2026-01-21 08:30–09:15

I attached a simple usage template to help populate the numbers ahead of the workshop. Can you confirm which slot works best and whether procurement/security should join?

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[attachment: Stratos_usage_forecast_Q1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Intro follow-up — workshop to align on sizing & pricing

Looping in Neha for procurement headcount and Markus for pricing guidance.

Ben — the times look good. My only ask: can we reserve ~10m at the end for a quick callout on network/PEM requirements (VPC, egress, on-prem footprint) since that will materially affect sizing? I can prepare two scenario slides: "Launch-week peak" and "steady-state."

I also attached a short Redwood sizing cheat sheet that maps tokens/sec throughput to GPU counts for dedicated pools — should help make the options concrete.

— Soojin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — this is perfect.

We'd like to include:
- Ethan (platform lead) to walk through anticipated concurrency & latency targets
- our procurement mailbox for initial commercial questions
- DevSecOps to confirm network/perimeter constraints (they're strict about egress)

Preferred slot: Tue 2026-01-20 12:00–12:45 PST. If that's tight, we can also do Wed 2026-01-21 08:30–09:15 PST.

Quick ask: can you also bring a sample SOW outline and a draft pricing sheet for a 6‑month reserved commitment? Procurement will want line items.

Appreciate it —

Head of Data Platforms | Stratos Analytics

Neha — can you be on the line for the procurement questions? If we need a separate procurement-only follow-up I'll coordinate but aim to cover initial questions in the workshop.

Hi Ben / Markus —

Procurement here. A couple quick items so we can review internal approvals pre-workshop:
- Please include a line for cancellation/termination notice in the SOW (30/60/90-day options)
- Provide estimated monthly spend ranges for the reserved commitment vs on-demand (sample invoices or blended rate helps)
- If possible, include any standard SOC2 attestations or where we can find them

We can join Tue 1/20 12:00. If you want a separate commercial deep-dive after the technical session that's fine.

Thanks —
